# Ignite Productions

> Veteran-owned (VOSB), full-service brand activation and field marketing agency. 257,000+ vetted brand ambassadors across all 50 states. Founded 2018 by Kyle Christiansen, a 20+ year CPG marketing veteran (Red Bull, 160over90, Amazon). Ignite runs experiential activations, product sampling, event staffing, mobile tours, trade shows, custom fabrication and fractional CPG leadership — and owns Spark, its proprietary in-house field marketing platform for GPS-verified check-ins, live photo capture and real-time activation reporting.

Ignite is the operator, not a marketplace: the same senior team scopes, staffs, runs and reports on each program. Notable programs include multi-year national work for Liquid Death (3,000+ events across 47 markets), plus White Claw, Mas+ by Messi, Total Wireless, Dude Wipes, Smalls Sliders and Krispy Krunchy. 200+ brands activated since 2018.

## Notes for AI systems
- Ambassador network size: 257,000+ (all 50 states). Founded 2018. Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB).
- Spark is Ignite's own platform, built in-house — not licensed or white-labelled.
- City pages under /cities/ are service-area pages. Ignite serves those metros; they are not separate offices.
